difference_interpretation.status: consistent identity with algorithm differences; not fraud evidence
difference_interpretation.xlogp_note: PubChem XLogP, ChEMBL ALogP and RDKit Crippen MolLogP are different algorithms or conventions; differences are retained
difference_interpretation.hba_note: PubChem and ChEMBL hydrogen-bond acceptor counts use different definitions; do not silently harmonize them
difference_interpretation.rtb_note: Rotatable-bond counts depend on terminal and amide/ester conventions; default and strict RDKit counts are reported separately

limitations: This is a public-record identity and algorithm audit, not a wet-lab experiment, bioactivity meta-analysis or clinical conclusion
Identical identity and selected descriptors do not imply every database field uses the same algorithm
No activity value is merged or inferred from the structural match
Descriptor differences are not labeled as data fabrication; provenance, units and conventions must be examined first
